contest_opportunities_registration_range.name: contest_opportunities_registration_range_check
contest_opportunities_registration_range.value: "contest_opportunities"."registration_ends_at" is null or "contest_opportunities"."registration_starts_at" is null or "contest_opportunities"."registration_ends_at" >= "contest_opportunities"."registration_starts_at"

contest_opportunities_notice_date_check.name: contest_opportunities_notice_date_check
contest_opportunities_notice_date_check.value: "contest_opportunities"."lifecycle_status" not in ('notice_published', 'registration_open', 'registration_closed', 'exam_scheduled', 'exam_held', 'result_published', 'homologated', 'closed') or "contest_opportunities"."notice_published_at" is not null

contest_opportunities_review_check.name: contest_opportunities_review_check
contest_opportunities_review_check.value:
"contest_opportunities"."editorial_status" <> 'reviewed' or (
        "contest_opportunities"."official_url" is not null
        and "contest_opportunities"."source_checked_at" is not null
        and "contest_opportunities"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null
        and "contest_opportunities"."reviewed_at" is not null
        and "contest_opportunities"."reviewed_at" >= "contest_opportunities"."source_checked_at"
        and "contest_opportunities"."published_at" is not null
      )

editorial_jobs_lease_check.name: editorial_jobs_lease_check
editorial_jobs_lease_check.value:
("editorial_automation_jobs"."status" = 'running' and "editorial_automation_jobs"."lease_token" is not null and "editorial_automation_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is not null)
      or ("editorial_automation_jobs"."status" <> 'running' and "editorial_automation_jobs"."lease_token" is null and "editorial_automation_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is null)

exam_editions_eligible_source_check.name: exam_editions_eligible_source_check
exam_editions_eligible_source_check.value:
"exam_editions"."status" not in ('held', 'published') or (
        "exam_editions"."official_url" is not null
        and char_length(btrim("exam_editions"."official_url")) > 0
        and "exam_editions"."source_checked_at" is not null
      )

legal_source_snapshots_review_check.name: legal_source_snapshots_review_check
legal_source_snapshots_review_check.value: "legal_source_snapshots"."status" <> 'approved' or ("legal_source_snapshots"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null and "legal_source_snapshots"."reviewed_at" is not null)

legal_text_snapshots_review_check.name: legal_text_snapshots_review_check
legal_text_snapshots_review_check.value: "legal_text_snapshots"."status" <> 'approved' or ("legal_text_snapshots"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null and "legal_text_snapshots"."reviewed_at" is not null)

legal_versions_date_range_check.name: legal_versions_date_range_check
legal_versions_date_range_check.value: "legal_versions"."valid_until" is null or "legal_versions"."valid_from" is null or "legal_versions"."valid_until" >= "legal_versions"."valid_from"

opportunity_analysis_snapshots_window_ch.name: opportunity_analysis_snapshots_window_check
opportunity_analysis_snapshots_window_ch.value:
"opportunity_analysis_snapshots"."window_start_year" between 2000 and 2200
        and "opportunity_analysis_snapshots"."window_end_year" between "opportunity_analysis_snapshots"."window_start_year" and 2200
        and "opportunity_analysis_snapshots"."window_end_year" - "opportunity_analysis_snapshots"."window_start_year" + 1 = "opportunity_analysis_snapshots"."lookback_years"

opportunity_analysis_snapshots_review_ch.name: opportunity_analysis_snapshots_review_check
opportunity_analysis_snapshots_review_ch.value:
"opportunity_analysis_snapshots"."status" <> 'reviewed' or (
        "opportunity_analysis_snapshots"."sample_size" > 0
        and nullif(btrim("opportunity_analysis_snapshots"."corpus_rights_reference"), '') is not null
        and "opportunity_analysis_snapshots"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null
        and "opportunity_analysis_snapshots"."reviewed_at" is not null
      )

opportunity_document_snapshots_review_ch.name: opportunity_document_snapshots_review_check
opportunity_document_snapshots_review_ch.value: "opportunity_document_snapshots"."status" <> 'approved' or ("opportunity_document_snapshots"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null and "opportunity_document_snapshots"."reviewed_at" is not null)

opportunity_document_snapshots_independe.name: opportunity_document_snapshots_independent_review_check
opportunity_document_snapshots_independe.value:
"opportunity_document_snapshots"."status" <> 'approved'
        or "opportunity_document_snapshots"."initiated_by_user_id" is null
        or "opportunity_document_snapshots"."reviewed_by_user_id" <> "opportunity_document_snapshots"."initiated_by_user_id"
        or ("opportunity_document_snapshots"."approval_basis" = 'owner_override'
          and "opportunity_document_snapshots"."authorization_scope" = 'owner-approval-2026-09-01'
          and "opportunity_document_snapshots"."authorized_by_user_id" is not null
          and "opportunity_document_snapshots"."authorized_by_user_id" = "opportunity_document_snapshots"."reviewed_by_user_id")

opportunity_organizer_assignments_bank_c.name: opportunity_organizer_assignments_bank_check
opportunity_organizer_assignments_bank_c.value:
("opportunity_organizer_assignments"."responsible_type" <> 'institutional_commission' or "opportunity_organizer_assignments"."quiz_bank_id" is null)
        and ("opportunity_organizer_assignments"."role" <> 'logistics_provider' or "opportunity_organizer_assignments"."quiz_bank_id" is null)

opportunity_organizer_assignments_review.name: opportunity_organizer_assignments_review_check
opportunity_organizer_assignments_review.value: "opportunity_organizer_assignments"."status" <> 'reviewed' or ("opportunity_organizer_assignments"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null and "opportunity_organizer_assignments"."reviewed_at" is not null)

opportunity_requirements_topic_subject_c.name: opportunity_requirements_topic_subject_check
opportunity_requirements_topic_subject_c.value: "opportunity_requirements"."topic_id" is null or "opportunity_requirements"."subject_id" is not null

opportunity_requirements_article_act_che.name: opportunity_requirements_article_act_check
opportunity_requirements_article_act_che.value: "opportunity_requirements"."legal_article_id" is null or "opportunity_requirements"."legal_act_id" is not null

opportunity_requirements_review_check.name: opportunity_requirements_review_check
opportunity_requirements_review_check.value: "opportunity_requirements"."editorial_status" <> 'reviewed' or ("opportunity_requirements"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null and "opportunity_requirements"."reviewed_at" is not null)

opportunity_source_documents_review_chec.name: opportunity_source_documents_review_check
opportunity_source_documents_review_chec.value: "opportunity_source_documents"."status" <> 'approved' or ("opportunity_source_documents"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null and "opportunity_source_documents"."reviewed_at" is not null)

questions_exam_original_order_uidx.name: questions_exam_original_order_uidx
questions_exam_original_order_uidx.where: "questions"."exam_edition_id" is not null and "questions"."original_question_order" is not null

questions_generator_metadata_check.name: questions_generator_metadata_check
questions_generator_metadata_check.value:
"questions"."authorship_method" = 'human' or (
        nullif(btrim("questions"."generator_model"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("questions"."prompt_version"), '') is not null
      )

questions_mode_relations_check.name: questions_mode_relations_check
questions_mode_relations_check.value:
(
        "questions"."quiz_mode" = 'dry_law'
        and "questions"."legal_article_id" is not null
        and "questions"."exam_edition_id" is null
        and "questions"."style_bank_id" is null
      ) or (
        "questions"."quiz_mode" = 'original_style'
        and "questions"."legal_article_id" is not null
        and "questions"."subject_id" is not null
        and "questions"."exam_edition_id" is null
        and "questions"."style_bank_id" is not null
        and "questions"."source_rights" = 'original_authorial'
        and nullif(btrim("questions"."learning_objective"), '') is not null
      ) or (
        "questions"."quiz_mode" = 'previous_exam'
        and "questions"."subject_id" is not null
        and "questions"."exam_edition_id" is not null
        and "questions"."style_bank_id" is null
        and "questions"."source_rights" = 'licensed'
      )

questions_original_responsibility_check.name: questions_original_responsibility_check
questions_original_responsibility_check.value:
"questions"."quiz_mode" <> 'original_style'
        or "questions"."editorial_status" = 'draft'
        or (
          "questions"."created_by_user_id" is not null
          and "questions"."clean_room_attested_at" is not null
        )

questions_topic_subject_check.name: questions_topic_subject_check
questions_topic_subject_check.value: "questions"."topic_id" is null or "questions"."subject_id" is not null

questions_previous_exam_provenance_check.name: questions_previous_exam_provenance_check
questions_previous_exam_provenance_check.value:
"questions"."quiz_mode" <> 'previous_exam' or (
        nullif(btrim("questions"."source_title"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("questions"."source_url"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("questions"."source_rights_holder"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("questions"."license_basis"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("questions"."license_reference"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("questions"."original_question_number"), '') is not null
        and "questions"."original_question_order" is not null
        and "questions"."original_question_order" > 0
        and "questions"."licensed_at" is not null
      )

questions_license_period_check.name: questions_license_period_check
questions_license_period_check.value: "questions"."license_expires_at" is null or "questions"."licensed_at" is null or "questions"."license_expires_at" > "questions"."licensed_at"

questions_submission_check.name: questions_submission_check
questions_submission_check.value:
"questions"."editorial_status" not in ('pending_review', 'reviewed')
        or "questions"."quiz_mode" <> 'original_style'
        or "questions"."submitted_at" is not null

quiz_sessions_path_selection_check.name: quiz_sessions_path_selection_check
quiz_sessions_path_selection_check.value:
("quiz_sessions"."path" = 'career' and "quiz_sessions"."career_track_id" is not null)
        or ("quiz_sessions"."path" = 'bank' and "quiz_sessions"."bank_id" is not null)

quiz_sessions_specialization_check.name: quiz_sessions_specialization_check
quiz_sessions_specialization_check.value: "quiz_sessions"."specialization_id" is null or "quiz_sessions"."career_track_id" is not null

quiz_sessions_topic_check.name: quiz_sessions_topic_check
quiz_sessions_topic_check.value: "quiz_sessions"."topic_id" is null or "quiz_sessions"."subject_id" is not null

quiz_sessions_exam_edition_check.name: quiz_sessions_exam_edition_check
quiz_sessions_exam_edition_check.value:
"quiz_sessions"."exam_edition_id" is null or (
        "quiz_sessions"."exam_scope" = 'latest'
        and (
          "quiz_sessions"."path" = 'career'
          or ("quiz_sessions"."path" = 'bank' and "quiz_sessions"."mode" = 'previous_exam')
        )
      )

quiz_sessions_deadline_check.name: quiz_sessions_deadline_check
quiz_sessions_deadline_check.value:
("quiz_sessions"."timed" and "quiz_sessions"."deadline_at" is not null
        and "quiz_sessions"."deadline_at" > "quiz_sessions"."started_at"
        and "quiz_sessions"."deadline_at" <= "quiz_sessions"."expires_at")
        or (not "quiz_sessions"."timed" and "quiz_sessions"."deadline_at" is null)

stripe_connect_split_rules_effective_per.name: stripe_connect_split_rules_effective_period_check
stripe_connect_split_rules_effective_per.value: "stripe_connect_split_rules"."effective_until" is null or "stripe_connect_split_rules"."effective_from" is null or "stripe_connect_split_rules"."effective_until" > "stripe_connect_split_rules"."effective_from"

stripe_connect_transfer_batches_provider.name: stripe_connect_transfer_batches_provider_reference_check
stripe_connect_transfer_batches_provider.value:
"stripe_connect_transfer_batches"."provider_payment_intent_id" is not null
        or "stripe_connect_transfer_batches"."provider_invoice_id" is not null
        or "stripe_connect_transfer_batches"."provider_charge_id" is not null
